snippet.title: Progress Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Mid Development Trailer for Cardstronaut, a rogue-lite deck-builder where you play as a space engineer to save your team members and the base from aliens by building decks and creating powerful synergies.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3177510/Cardstronaut/

Discord: https://discord.gg/EbcPjYSRsk
